protected_invariants: the reviewed verdict stays receipt-authoritative: receipt bytes, not stdout and not the exit status, remain the evidence of record
receipt reviewed_head_sha stays bound to the exact reviewed commit, and a receipt for any other head is never accepted as a verdict
a receipt whose payload integrity digest does not recompute is never accepted, so a partially written or edited receipt never becomes a PASS
the reviewer stays a fresh, separate, ephemeral Codex process in a detached read-only exact-head worktree, and no isolation, provenance or model-pinning semantics change
P0/P1/P2 remain the blocking severities and P3 remains non-blocking; no severity threshold is relaxed
STALE_TOOLING still never satisfies merge readiness or a current exact-head review requirement
the wait primitive never returns control silently: an absent, unreadable, wrong-head or timed-out receipt is an explicit non-zero failure state
the wait primitive never infers liveness from a command-line pattern, and never observes a fixed receipt filename that the writer does not produce
forbidden_side_effects: contacting The Odds API, B2, AWS, Cloudflare or any other provider, and any provider quota consumption
creating, modifying, uploading or deleting any backup generation or remote object
Stage D start, Gate 3 authorization, or any change to Blocker 1/2/3 or Gate 2 status
production, transaction, RAW, ledger, quota or canonical identity mutation
scheduler activation, training, prediction, backtest or model activation
production-gate.yml, remote CI scope loading, or CI receipt transport changes
force push, direct main push, self-review or self-merge
